Prevents accidential update of an existing site. If there are any files in the subfolder where the site should be placed, the function will throw.

## CLI flag

```text
--throw-if-site-exists
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion lambda sites create`](/docs/lambda/cli/sites/create)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`deploySite()`](/docs/lambda/deploysite#throwifsiteexists)
- [`deploySiteFromBundle()`](/docs/lambda/deploysitefrombundle#throwifsiteexists)
